WITH SRC1 AS (
SELECT
	ACN_ID, isActive, isLatest, COUNT(*) CNT
FROM
	BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT
WHERE
	isLatest = 1
GROUP BY
	ACN_ID, isActive, isLatest
HAVING
	COUNT(*) > 1),
SRC2 AS
(SELECT
    ACN_ID, FILE_NAME
FROM
    BUSC.ATM_ACCOUNT)
SELECT
    SRC2.ACN_ID, FILE_NAME
FROM
    SRC2
INNER JOIN SRC1 ON SRC1.ACN_ID = SRC2.ACN_ID;
